digest.component_or_area: pending-binding recovery gate in outbound reconciliation
propositions: preview and --mode dry-run passes (both documented as no-write) perform remote Jira writes during pending-binding recovery due to an unguarded recovery gate
run_differs._run_differs_outbound guards pending-binding recovery only on scoped_ids condition, with no persist/no-write axis check before calling binding_store.recover_pending_bindings
the keyed-pending branch of recovery issues remote client.add_label and client.set_entity_property mutations that are not suppressed on no-write passes
the fix is to gate recovery on both conditions: if not scoped_ids and ctx.persist, making recovery suppression symmetric with sibling invariant-filing gate
a no-write pass with keyed-pending binding must perform zero remote identity writes; a live pass must preserve existing recovery behavior unchanged
